definition_used: Any question, controversy or dispute about published content, or undefined sections of it.
caution: The definition is too broad and non-specific to assign any manuscript-facing category reliably. It functions as a catch-all notice of unresolved concerns without indicating whether the issue pertains to research content, authorship, editorial processes, or post-publication oversight.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a general notice of controversy or dispute about published content without specifying the nature of the concern. It lacks the specificity required to map to any of the four manuscript-facing categories, which require more concrete indications of problems with research reliability, attribution, editorial governance, or post-publication processes.
